description: What the client sees for each AI area (key: the area id of data/ai/ai_areas.json, used by SMEs, agents and scripts; value: the plain label shown in the questionnaire, in the covers note, the Area column and the AI system inventory question). Decided by the user 2026-10-29. Client text only: changing a label never makes the mapping or a bank stale. A test checks every area has one.

labels.internal_process: AI used in your internal decisions and workflows (HR, finance, approvals, operations)
labels.code_generation: AI that writes or suggests code for your developers
labels.customer_facing: AI your customers or the public talk to or get answers from
labels.vendor_ai: AI features inside the products and services you buy (e.g. Jira, Slack, ServiceNow)
labels.model_building: Building or tuning your own AI model
labels.invisible_usage: AI used without your approval: staff tools nobody approved, and outside AI agents reaching your systems
labels.input: What people and systems send to the AI (prompts, pasted text, files)
labels.output: The AI's answers and how people and systems rely on them
labels.test_tuning_data: The data you train, tune and test your model with
labels.model: Your own model itself (its weights, settings and instructions)
labels.source_data: Your data the AI looks up to answer
labels.mcp_tools: Tools and systems the AI can use or act on
labels.agent: AI that carries out tasks on its own with little human oversight
labels.hosting: Servers and cloud where you run AI models yourself
